Unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the batchSend loop; can silently wrap around.

edges.reason: transfer forwards the caller-supplied msg.sender as the source of the transfer.
transferFrom compares and charges msg.sender against the allowance ledger.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] supplied by the caller.
delegate authorization depends entirely on msg.sender equalling one of the six privileged addresses.
batchSend authorization depends entirely on msg.sender equalling one of the six privileged addresses.
Constructor binds owner and the initial balance to the deploying msg.sender.
msg.sender gates execution of the delegatecall payload.
transfer._to flows into the forwarded transferFrom call.
transfer._value flows into the forwarded transferFrom call.
transferFrom._from is used for allowance and balance lookups.
transferFrom._to receives the credited balance.
User-supplied _value is subtracted from the allowance without SafeMath, enabling underflow.
approve._spender becomes the approval key.
approve._value becomes the stored approval amount.
delegate.a is the callee address chosen by the privileged caller.
delegate.b is the raw bytecode calldata forwarded to delegatecall.
batchSend._tos drives the distribution loop.
batchSend._value is multiplied by the array length and credited per recipient.
Locally computed total feeds the unchecked balance subtraction in batchSend.
balanceOf values are decremented without SafeMath in transferFrom.
balanceOf[msg.sender] is decremented by an unchecked total in batchSend.
balanceOf[_to] is incremented with unchecked arithmetic in the batchSend loop.
The allowance ledger is mutated by an unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
owner is one of the accepted authorizers for delegate.

Constructor grants the router constant an infinite allowance.
The computed Uniswap pair (derived from the router constant family) acts as an extra whitelisted sender in ensure.
totalSupply is initialized in the constructor.
name is initialized in the constructor.
symbol is initialized in the constructor.
balanceOf[msg.sender] is set to the full supply in the constructor.
allowance[msg.sender][router] is set to uint(-1) in the constructor.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom.
transferFrom execution is gated by the ensure modifier which whitelists privileged addresses and the pair.
delegate performs an external delegatecall to an arbitrary address, giving that code full control of this contract's storage and execution.

normalization_plan.reason: transfer._to is a transient parameter of the transfer function and carries no independent semantic identity.
transfer._value is a transient amount parameter used only to forward the call.
transferFrom._from is a transient source-address parameter of transferFrom.
transferFrom._to is a transient destination-address parameter of transferFrom.
transferFrom._value is the user-controlled amount fed directly into the unchecked allowance subtraction.
approve._spender is a transient key parameter of the approve function.
approve._value is a transient approval amount parameter.
delegate.a is the caller-chosen target address of the delegate function.
delegate.b is the raw payload consumed by the delegatecall operation.
batchSend._tos is a transient recipient array parameter of batchSend.
batchSend._value is a transient per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend.
ensure._from is a transient parameter of the ensure modifier whitelist check.
ensure._to is a transient parameter of the ensure modifier whitelist check.
batchSend.total is a temporary aggregate that directly feeds the unchecked balance subtraction.
batchSend.i is a loop counter with no independent semantic meaning.
batchSend._to is the loop-local recipient whose balance is credited with unchecked addition.
